title: Invoked
gamePlan: Search Invocation with Aleister, then use Fusion materials from the hand, field and graveyards. Recycle Invocation and Aleister for later turns.
strengths: A compact Fusion engine leaves room for disruption.
Invocation can use opposing graveyard materials.
weaknesses: Interrupting Aleister’s search can stop access to Invocation.
Graveyard disruption limits material access and recycling.
suggestions: Test opening hands and disruption points against the published list. Check current format restrictions before play.

title: Power Patron
gamePlan: Use Medius to access a Power Patron monster, then sequence the Fusion, Synchro and Xyz engines around their Extra Deck restrictions.
strengths: Medius can search or directly summon an engine piece.
Different summoning engines offer varied removal options.
weaknesses: Power Patron engine monsters impose different Extra Deck locks.
Multi-engine hands require careful sequencing and can conflict.
suggestions: Test opening hands and disruption points against the published list. Check current format restrictions before play.

title: Xenovader△
gamePlan: Build face-down banished resources to enable the Xenovader effects; plan around the deck cards spent as fuel.
strengths: The published list mixes engine access with disruption.
weaknesses: Banishing deck cards can remove essential follow-up pieces.
Resource thresholds require setup before stronger effects become available.
suggestions: Test opening hands and disruption points against the published list. Check current format restrictions before play.

title: Branded Dracotail
gamePlan: Combine Branded Fusion plays with Dracotail material effects. Faimena enables a Quick Effect Fusion Summon and sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap when used as material.
strengths: Fusion materials can generate follow-up Spell/Trap access.
Faimena offers Fusion play during the Main Phase.
weaknesses: Discarding and consuming materials requires resource planning.
Search interruption and graveyard removal can reduce follow-up.
suggestions: Test opening hands and disruption points against the published list. Check current format restrictions before play.

title: Ars Magna Elfnote
gamePlan: Use Medius for engine access and Lucina to search Elfnote monsters. Preserve the center Main Monster Zone for Elfnote effects.
strengths: Lucina can summon itself and search a partner.
Its opponent-turn effect offers positional interaction and a bounce.
weaknesses: Once-per-turn effects make interrupted searches significant.
suggestions: Test opening hands and disruption points against the published list. Check current format restrictions before play.
